verdict.rationale: Quo is a business phone and communications SaaS that could plausibly ship an official CLI, so the axis applies. The evidence documents a public REST API, OpenAPI specs, a Try-it playground, and an official MCP server, but nothing describes an official command-line tool. API and MCP access are adjacent capabilities and earn no credit here.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can use an official CLI
